messages:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding Atlas-2 (v1) to the hosted model catalog. We uploaded weights to s3://redwood-models/atlas2/v1/ (model.safetensors, tokenizer.json) and a preliminary model_card.md. Draft customer note is here: https://go.redwood/docs/atlas2-caveats (WIP).

maria: Quick checklist I need help with:
  1) eng-ml: confirm model_config (max_seq, kv cache, vocab_size).
  2) eng-runtime: add q4f16 variant to catalog + kernel prefs.
  3) docs: review customer-facing capability notes and quirks.
  4) qa: run tokenization smoke on our eval sets.

cheng: Quick question — what max_seq_len should we serve as default? model_card.md says 4096 but the config I peeked at looked like 2048.

alex: I ran a quick tokenizer smoke. Found that token id 0 is being used for a special BOS token in this tokenizer which conflicts with our padding conventions. Causes off-by-one in some chat tests (leading space on replies).

alex: I'll add a conversion layer in the loader that remaps id 0 -> <pad> and shifts the rest by +1. Will open a PR.

maria: Good catch. We should avoid a customer-visible regression. If we remap, add a migration path and note in release docs.

tj: Model config snippet I'd propose (please review):

```
model: atlas2
version: v1
weights_path: s3://redwood-models/atlas2/v1/model.safetensors
framework: torch
dtype: fp16
max_seq_len: 4096
kv_cache: true
vocab_size: 50288
tokenizer: s3://redwood-models/atlas2/v1/tokenizer.json
```

deploy-bot: CI: model-upload job completed for atlas2/v1 — registry entry created: https://internal.redwood/models/atlas2/v1 :white_check_mark:

cheng: I'll review tj's config. If the underlying weights were trained with 4096 context we should set that. I want to run a quick forward pass with 4096 to confirm memory fits on our fp16 kernels.

alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/842 — tokenizer remap + unit tests (tokenization roundtrip + sample chat assertion). cc @cheng

cheng: Reviewing now. Also flag for eng-runtime: Atlas-2 benefits from flash_attn2 kernels for perf. Can you add preferred_kernels: [flash_attn2, triton] to the registry entry? @eng-runtime

tj: For rollout/canary, plan: canary route -> atlas2:v1-fp16 on a small fleet, q4f16 fallback if mem constrained. Example rollout config I pushed to infra repo. Use this route: /models/atlas2?variant=canary

sina: Docs: I'll take the customer-facing notes. Suggested capability blurb: "Atlas-2: strong summarization and code-assist; excels at multi-turn condense tasks." Also note a known quirk: "tokenizer may produce an extra leading space on model replies when used with some client libraries; recommended workaround: post-process with strip()."

docs-bot: Draft announcement page created: https://internal.redwood/docs/drafts/atlas2-announce — please leave inline comments.

alex: FYI my tokenizer remap has a small perf cost on first tokenization pass (cached thereafter). Added tests and a short note in the model loader that we can toggle the remap via config flag `tokenizer_remap: true`.

cheng: If remap is opt-in default true, fine. I'll bench end-to-end with 4096 seq on our fp16 runtime and report numbers by EOD.

maria: Blockers: PR merge for tokenizer, config sign-off from cheng, docs sign-off from sina. If all green I plan to schedule a customer announcement 11:00 PT tomorrow with the canary route enabled. :rocket:

alex: Pinged @sina for docs review in the PR and added a short example snippet demonstrating the strip() workaround.

sina: Reviewed draft, left two phrasing suggestions, added capability examples and a short FAQ entry about tokenization. Will approve after the wording tweak.

cheng: Bench results: 4096 forward passes fit on our p3dn-like nodes with fp16 but perf drops ~8% vs 2048. Flash_attn2 gives ~12% perf win in our tests. I will add kernel pref to registry entry.

maria: Awesome — thanks. Can we also add a small customer note recommending max_prompt_len to stay <=3000 for best latency/quality balance?

sina: Added that recommendation to the docs draft and the FAQ.

maria: Final checklist:
  - [x] weights uploaded
  - [x] registry entry created
  - [x] tokenizer PR opened
  - [ ] tokenizer PR merged (cheng)
  - [ ] runtime kernel prefs added (eng-runtime)
  - [ ] docs approved (sina)

maria: If we clear the last two items I'll flip the canary and post the customer announcement. Thanks all!
